content.title: Maharashtra SP Leader Calls for Age Change in Juvenile Law
content.caption: A Maharashtra SP leader urges to lower the juvenile age threshold to 15 and emphasizes the need for stricter action against such incidents.

slides.heading: Maharashtra SP Leader Calls for Age Change in Juvenile Law
slides.text: A Maharashtra SP leader urges to lower the juvenile age threshold to 15 and emphasizes the need for stricter action against such incidents.

slides.heading: Incident Details
slides.text: A couple was assaulted at a garden in Kurla by a group of minors.

slides.heading: Political Reaction
slides.text: Various political parties condemned the assault and called for stricter action.
